text: BAM routing fell 0.05 percentage points over 22 hours, extending a 0.23 percentage-point decline over 7 days to 32.7% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 23.6% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 70 leadership changes in the window are best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover; only one validated structural rollover is in the record.
